summary: Excellent PowerShell patterns: Set-StrictMode, $ErrorActionPreference='Stop', proper module structure, quoted variables. Workflow properly uses shell:pwsh, least-privilege permissions (contents:read), pinned refs, job outputs/dependencies. Error handling is comprehensive with clear messages. The cartesian product + include/exclude logic is intricate but well-commented. Concerns: (1) MatrixGenerator.Tests.ps1 referenced in workflow but not shown—cannot verify unit tests pass; (2) fixture files (fixtures/*.json) referenced in Run-ActTests.ps1 but not provided—needed for act tests; (3) actionlint/act validation cannot be run without test suite. Code structure and quality suggest these will work. The adapter functions (Get-ObjectKey, etc.) add slight overhead but unify PSCustomObject/IDictionary handling well. Minor: test expectations hardcoded in Run-ActTests.ps1 (lines ~52-67) require exact matrix JSON matching—maintainable but brittle if logic changes.
